name: shiksha-learning-preferences-tutorial
title: Personalize your learning preferences

chapters.caption: 01  Open Learner profile from the course's TA actions menu.
02  Tell the tutor how you prefer explanations and practice to be presented.
03  Save the instructions and return to your course conversation.
04  Your next teaching turn carries the saved instructions.
05  Reopen the profile to confirm the preference is saved, not just typed.

description: Save custom learner instructions, verify they reach the next chat turn, and reopen the saved preference.
capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
